scope: Operational storage/nativecase presence only; publicsourcecount includes original and derivativepublicdisclosures and indexonlyHTML. No financial adoption/readiness judgement. Existing fileonly research beyondDB not enumerated.

read_only_query_definitions.source_coverage: SELECT company_id,count(*),sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(data,'$.source_type')='public_disclosure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(data,'$.metadata.provider')='project_disclosed_fact_normalization' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM sources GROUP BY company_id
read_only_query_definitions.native_heads: SELECT v.data FROM qualitative_case_versions v JOIN (SELECT case_id,max(version) version FROM qualitative_case_versions GROUP BY case_id) h ON h.case_id=v.case_id AND h.version=v.version
read_only_query_definitions.native_head_version: SELECT max(version) FROM qualitative_case_versions WHERE case_id=?
